title: HEME
author: GuiltyComplaint6427
selftext:
# My First Game Ever — A Childhood Dream Finally Came True

Hi everyone!

This is my first ever game, something I've dreamed of making since I was a kid who loved playing video games.

I've never studied game development, and I don't have a team. I developed this game on my own, learning everything along the way.

I did use AI-generated tools for some of the visual assets. I'm honestly not an expert at using AI either. I just experimented, made mistakes, tried different things, and learned as I went.

The game is called **HEME: The Phenomenon of Inner Duality**.

It's a short 2D side-scrolling narrative game about two sisters and a mysterious presence they have lived with for a long time. It's a story about love, connection, and letting go.

It's a small game, and I honestly don't know if I'll make another one. Maybe it's time to find a regular job again. Haha.

But at least, I can say that I finally made my own game and got it released on Steam.

For someone who once only dreamed of making games, that's already something special.

I'd love to hear what you think!

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4395840/HEME/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4395840/HEME/)
